defects.quote: All 2312 recorded errors are in the checkout transaction scope, and the error profile groups them as frontend.request_error
defects.why: The matching checkout whole-run count and OpenSearch error-group count do not prove they are the same events or that the error-profile events belong to checkout.

defects.quote: All 2312 errors in the transaction scope are attributed to the checkout transaction ... and the error profile groups them as frontend.request_error
defects.why: This treats matching aggregates from the transaction summary and error store as a shared set of events despite their different sources and scopes.

notes: The verdicts, coverage, policy-window numbers, and operator actions are otherwise accurate, but the unsupported cross-source error attribution is misleading.
